text: 证监会核准博迈基金管理（中国）有限公司作为合格境内机构投资者从事境外证券投资管理业务，公司应当据此办理变更业务范围手续。
text_en: The CSRC approved Neuberger Berman Fund Management (China) Co., Ltd. to engage in overseas securities investment management business as a qualified domestic institutional investor, and the company shall accordingly complete procedures to change its business scope.
